field.label: Enable
field.help: Enable AdIdentity session ingest and alias updates.

field.label: Shared token
field.help: Bearer token shared with the Windows Agent.

field.label: Agent base URL
field.help: Example: https://dc01.corp.local:8443 — with plain http the shared token is sent in clear text.

field.label: Skip agent certificate validation
field.help: Leave off. Only for an agent with a self-signed certificate: resync sends the shared token, and an unverified connection lets anyone answering on that address collect it.

field.label: Monitored groups
field.help: One AD group name per line. Only these groups become aliases.

field.label: Enable user aliases
field.help: Optional: create per-user aliases (one IP each).

field.label: User alias prefix
field.help: Prefix for optional user aliases, default u_

field.label: Require ASCII names for aliases
field.help: IMPORTANT: AD group and user names that become firewall aliases must use English (ASCII) characters only — Latin letters, digits, spaces, - _ . Cyrillic or other scripts are refused with an error (they would otherwise collapse to one shared alias "unknown"). Rename the group/user in Active Directory. Leave this checked unless you are replacing the policy (see D28 in PROJECT_STATE).
